Stories.

Real ways people run their money with Lightning, told on LinkedIn and Reddit. Read what they shared, or share your own and earn coins for the marketplace.

  1. Save a draftAdd a title and short summary to get your verification code.
  2. Write your postShare a general money-management habit on LinkedIn or Reddit. Include your code and a link back to Lightning.
  3. Submit the linkPaste the post link, accept the community rules and send your listing for review.
  4. Earn coinsA moderator verifies the post and may award coins for your marketplace wallet.

Latest posts

Share your post

Drafts are private. Listing needs your consent and a public, adult-confirmed profile. Editing a listed post takes it down until it is reviewed again.

Add at least one link. Your draft gets a verification code: paste it into your post together with a link to Lightning.

  • Coins reward the post, never likes, votes, comments or the link alone, and each post can be rewarded once.
  • Up to 3 rewarded posts in any 30 days. Add your verification code and a link to Lightning so we can review your submission.
  • Never include account numbers, balances you want private or anything identifying. Posts are personal experiences, not financial advice.

Sign in or manage your account

Moderation queue

Open the external post yourself and look for the verification code. Rank points raise the leaderboard; coins are spendable and never raise rank. Each is paid once per post.

Community rules

Only general money-management experiences and educational tips are accepted.

Solicitation, advertising or offering financial services, and personalized financial or investment advice are prohibited. Violations will result in removal of the content and a ban from the community.

External platforms

Posts may link to third-party platforms. Lightning does not control those platforms and is not responsible for communications, transactions, services or other interactions conducted outside this website, subject to applicable law. Official checkout purchases remain governed by our payment terms.
